gre_subject.value: The Physics GRE is optional; if sent, it is only looked at after initial screening.
gre_subject.quote: For several years now, the GRE Physics score has been optional.

gre_general.value: GRE General scores are not considered at all.
gre_general.quote: Scores on the General Test will not be considered at all.

supervisor.value: Admission is from a common pool, not by research groups; name potential advisors but no commitment is needed. Most choose an advisor after starting.
supervisor.quote: You should describe your research interests and name one or more potential advisors in your application, but you do not need to obtain commitments from them to advise or support you.

funding.value: The department aims to support students with TA or RA stipends for the whole PhD, subject to progress and funding.
funding.quote: We endeavor to provide TA or RA support and a stipend for the entire duration of study at Illinois Astronomy (based on student progress and funding availability).

entry_route.value: A bachelor's in physical science or engineering is enough; a master's can be earned en route.
entry_route.quote: Education: Bachelor's degree in physical science or engineering.

notes: Exactly three letters. The department offers no fee waivers beyond the Graduate College's.
